decisions.reason: Although its later web visibility is unclear, the training programme draws directly on the firm's machinery, application consulting, and training know-how, so absorptive capacity is high and it is more likely to be retained, perhaps in integrated form, than withdrawn.

The fourth rotary axis accessory builds on the firm's installed machine base, modular engineering, and customer process knowledge, giving the firm strong ability to improve and commercialize it and therefore a good case for keeping it.

Hybrid additive post-processing is relatively distant from the firm's established knowledge base, so despite its R&D capability the firm is less able to interpret market feedback and refine the product efficiently, making withdrawal more likely.

A high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the core of the firm's accumulated engineering, testing, service, and application expertise, and as a multi-model line in a growing market it is strongly favored for continuation.

The automatic tool change system closely complements the firm's existing machines and workflow optimization offer, and the firm's related knowledge and in-house development capacity make continued support and improvement likely.
